results.title: Las grullas
results.overview: Dr. Patricia Torres, a neonatologist, reflects on the experiences that have shaped her career at the hospital. For years, she has cared for premature babies whose lives begin in fragile circumstances. Inspired by a Japanese legend about a thousand paper cranes, she discovered a new way to understand neonatal care and the complex reality faced by families.

results.title: Miedo
results.overview: Katherine is admitted to a public psychiatric clinic following a suicide attempt. What begins as a search for care transforms into an experience marked by abuse and institutional neglect. Through her testimony and a visual reconstruction using stop-motion animation, the documentary explores the conditions of her confinement and the dynamics that normalize violence within mental health settings, challenging the very notion of protection and care.

results.title: Schurli - Der Liedermacher & Poet Georg Danzer
results.original_title: Schurli - Der Liedermacher & Poet Georg Danzer
results.overview: To many of his friends, fans, and companions, he was “Schurli”; to a wider audience, he was Georg Danzer: a singer-songwriter, poet, and subtle intellectual. He became famous for his Viennese wit and songs like “Jö Schau” and “Hupf in Gatsch.” But behind that twinkle in his eye lies far more than just humor and pop songs: political and poetic, often melancholic lyrics, sharp observations, and a deep connection to people on the margins of society. To mark his 80th birthday, this ORF documentary traces Georg Danzer’s life through his songs and writings—featuring rare archival footage, memories from friends and family, and previously unpublished notes. A personal look at “Schurli Danzer,” at Vienna, and at Viennese culture.

results.title: Something In The House
results.overview: A married couple and their daughter struggle with the child’s behavioral issues. The birth of a baby in the household disrupts an already fragile balance, pushing their shared life into disconcerting and darker directions.

results.title: Ceremony
results.overview: Before graduation, I made a wish for a heavy rain. There was a "one last time" in the wish. One month before that, my grandfather passed away. On the day before the burial, that was the "one last time" to see his face. Is there some ritualistic meaning hidden between "wish" and "the last"?

results.title: Beyond Dreams Door: 1980's Horror
results.overview: This Project Assembles 1 Second Shots From Over 200 Individual 1980's Horror Movies To Create A Rhythmic Montage Of Momentary Expressions And Image Relation. Throughout The Process Observing Connections And Repetitions To Form And Further The Concept With Each Brief Image.

results.title: Aash khanoom Jan
results.overview: It centers on the children of a traditional family who decide to travel to Tehran to visit their elderly parents after the pandemic ends. Arriving from various locations, they gather just as the family matriarch—affectionately known as "Khanom-Jan"—is preparing her annual *ash-e nazri* (a traditional ceremonial soup), leading to a series of bittersweet events.

results.title: Empowered
results.overview: Empowered follows seven remarkable Ukrainians — human-rights defender Oleksandra Matviichuk, singer Jamala, violinist Bohdana Pivnenko, kobzar Taras Kompanichenko, painter Anatolii Kryvolap, the band DakhaBrakha and cinematographer Serhii Mykhalchuk.  Through their work and everyday lives, the film shows a country that keeps making art, defending human rights and building its future even in the middle of a full-scale war. Its subject is not what Ukraine endures, but what Ukrainians go on creating and protecting.
